title: Design System: Gustavo Fontenelle Belmiro, Portfolio

hero-title.purpose: The three-line name and role at the bottom left of the home hero.

hero-title-stacked.purpose: The hero title in the single-column layout.

page-title.purpose: The h1 of the projects index, a case page and the 404.

stat.purpose: The three résumé numbers in About, tabular figures.

service-tab.purpose: The three service names, which are tabs.

next-title.purpose: The next-project link at the foot of a case page.

statement.purpose: The About paragraph that lights word by word.

row-title.purpose: A role in the experience list.

point.purpose: Ruled list items on a case page.

page-intro.purpose: The sentence under a page title.

intro.purpose: Service description and contact introduction, in Foreground.

lede.purpose: The hero sentence; field text uses the same size.

small.purpose: Pills, chips, captions, field errors, secondary lines, the footer.

brand.purpose: The owner's name in the top bar; 1.0625rem in the stacked layout and the footer.

menu-link.purpose: Links inside the open mobile menu, uppercase.

nav-link.purpose: Top bar links and the 'more' links, uppercase.

button.purpose: Buttons; the language switch, menu button and back link share the size, uppercase.

label.purpose: Geist Mono, uppercase. The heading of a section or of a block on a case page.

meta.purpose: Geist Mono, uppercase. Status, availability, definition terms, field labels, dates, counts.

shadows.name: card-stack
shadows.purpose: Home page sticky project cards only: falls upward so an arriving card separates from the one it covers.

shadows.name: ghost-outline
shadows.purpose: The ghost button's 1px outline; var(--fg) on hover.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Thickens a focused field's underline to 2px; var(--error) when invalid.

motion.name: ease
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: The one easing token (--ease): every transform and entrance.

motion.name: state
motion.value: 0.25s (default curve)
motion.purpose: Colour, background, border and underline-colour changes on hover; 0.4s on service tabs.

motion.name: press
motion.value: 0.35s var(--ease), scale(0.98)
motion.purpose: Button active state.

motion.name: icon-nudge
motion.value: 0.45s var(--ease), translate 3 to 6px (10px on the next-project arrow, 0.5s)
motion.purpose: A trailing line icon moves in its own direction on hover.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.value: 0.5s var(--ease), scaleX 0 to 1 from the left
motion.purpose: Top bar link under hover; stays for the current page or section.

motion.name: card-image
motion.value: 1.4s var(--ease), scale 1.04 to 1.09
motion.purpose: Card image eases in while its card is hovered. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-lines
motion.value: 1.3s var(--ease), translateY 110% to 0, delay line index * 110ms + 150ms
motion.purpose: Hero title lines rise from behind a mask on load.

motion.name: hero-fade
motion.value: 1.2s var(--ease), opacity, 0.75s delay (top bar: 0.15s delay)
motion.purpose: Hero sentence, actions and availability fade in; the top bar fades in.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0.9s, transform 1.1s (translateY 28px), filter 0.9s (blur 6px), var(--ease), neighbours 90ms apart
motion.purpose: Blocks enter once when they reach the viewport (Reveal).

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 0.8s var(--ease), from opacity 0, translateY 16px, blur 5px, items 45ms apart
motion.purpose: Service panel text and pills when the tab changes.

motion.name: tab-mark
motion.value: 0.6s var(--ease), scale 0 to 1
motion.purpose: The diamond's centre fills when a service tab is selected.

motion.name: count-up
motion.value: 1300ms exponential ease-out, once at 60% visibility
motion.purpose: Stat numbers count from zero (CountUp).

motion.name: scroll-words
motion.value: scroll-linked opacity, 8-word leading edge, floor 0.38 (0.5 below 1200px wide)
motion.purpose: The About statement lights word by word (ScrollWords).

motion.name: covered-card
motion.value: scroll-linked: scale 1 to 0.95 from the top edge, brightness 1 to 0.45
motion.purpose: A sticky project card recedes while the next one covers it.

motion.name: shot
motion.value: scroll-linked: crane (object-position Y), truck (object-position X), push (scale to --zoom, default 1.1, about a focus point)
motion.purpose: The case image is reframed inside its frame as the page scrolls (Shot).

motion.name: ping
motion.value: 2.6s var(--ease) infinite, opacity 0.7 to 0, scale 1 to 3.4
motion.purpose: The availability dot's ring.

motion.name: spin
motion.value: 0.8s linear infinite
motion.purpose: The sending spinner.

motion.name: page-change
motion.value: view transition groups 0.55s var(--ease); the project image is the shared element
motion.purpose: Navigation between pages, card to case.

motion.name: scene-camera
motion.value: one pose per section, smoothstep between section marks, damped per frame by 1 - exp(-5.5 * dt)
motion.purpose: The 3D scene's camera follows scroll.

motion.name: scene-intro
motion.value: 2400ms exponential ease-out: camera from 1.22x distance, ring from 1.55x radius and -1.5rad
motion.purpose: The scene assembles around the portrait on load.

motion.name: scene-idle
motion.value: ring 0.07 rad/s; pointer drift up to 0.5 / 0.28 world units, damped
motion.purpose: The ring turns on its own and the camera follows the mouse.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: entrances, loops and scroll-linked effects are declared only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; view transitions animation: none; scene holds the hero pose and fades over 0.7 viewport of scroll
motion.purpose: With reduced motion all content is complete and still; hover and press transitions remain.

narrative.overview:
A near-black page with cool pale text, very light type and hairline rules. The interface is kept quiet so that one thing can be strong: a three.js scene fixed behind the home page, in which a tilted ring of glass tiles carrying the owner's project screenshots turns around his black and white portrait. As the page scrolls, the camera moves to a new pose for each section. "The Orbit" names that object and nothing else; no part of the interface is themed after it.

The look was pinned by the owner: dark, minimal, his photo at the top, and visible animation with camera moves that orbit as the page scrolls. Minimal here means few elements and a lot of black, not little motion. Type is one family, Geist, at light weights and in sentence case; Geist Mono appears only in small uppercase labels, dates and status. The only chromatic colour in the interface is a green dot for a live project and for availability; project images bring the rest.

Density is low. Sections are separated by up to 184px of vertical space, large statements sit beside a narrow label column, and structure comes from 1px translucent white rules. Inner pages (the projects index and each case page) carry no 3D scene; they use the same type, rules, cards and scroll-linked image framing.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#050607) with cool pale text; neutrals only, plus one green signal dot.
One family: Geist Variable at weights 200 to 350 for display, 400 for reading; Geist Mono Variable for small uppercase labels only.
Display type is sentence case with negative tracking; uppercase is reserved for small tracked labels and controls (1rem and under).
Structure from 1px white hairlines at 10% and 20% opacity; one panel tone (#0d0f10) for cards.
Pale filled rectangles with a 6px radius for actions; full pills for tags, filters and the language switch.
One WebGL scene, home page only, masked away from the text and driven by scroll.
All entrance and scroll motion is opt-in under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`; without it the content is complete and still.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "this is reachable right now": a project with a working public link, or the owner's availability. It is always a dot of 8px or less, never text, a fill, a border or a hover colour.

rules.name: The Pale Fill Rule
rules.body: The chosen or primary thing is a Text-coloured fill with Ground-coloured type: the primary button, the pressed filter chip, the current language, the text selection. No hue is ever used for selection or emphasis.

rules.name: The Images Bring The Colour Rule
rules.body: Chromatic colour enters through project screenshots, in cards, case pages and on the 3D tiles. The portrait is black and white.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Anything set larger than body size is weight 200 to 350, sentence case, with negative tracking. Weight 500 and above belongs to type of 1.25rem and under.

rules.name: The Small Caps Only Rule
rules.body: Uppercase appears only at 1rem and under, always with positive tracking (0.08em to 0.2em). A heading, title or sentence is never set in capitals.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is used at 0.78rem and under for labels, dates, status and counts. It never sets a sentence, a title or a button.

rules.name: The Label Is The Heading Rule
rules.body: A mono label is the heading of its section (it is the h2), placed in the left columns beside the content or directly above a list. It is not a caption stacked over a second, larger heading.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The only cast shadow is the card stack's. Nothing else floats; the other two box-shadows are 1px lines.

rules.name: The Covered Card Rule
rules.body: While the next card slides over it, a sticky card scales down by up to 5% from its top edge and dims by up to 55% brightness. This is driven by scroll position, applies only in the wide layout, and is off under reduced motion.

dos: Do keep the ground at #050607 and build structure from 1px white rules at 10% and 20% opacity, with #0d0f10 as the only raised tone.
Do set anything larger than body text in Geist at weight 200 to 350, sentence case, with negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.04em).
Do keep uppercase for type of 1rem and under with 0.08em to 0.2em tracking, and Geist Mono for labels, dates, status and counts at 0.78rem and under.
Do mark the primary or chosen thing with a Text-coloured fill and Ground-coloured type.
Do use the radius that matches the part: 6px for buttons, 10px for cards and frames, a full pill for tags, chips and switches, none for fields.
Do keep the green dot for a project that is reachable now and for availability; list a project whose site is down without the dot and without a link.
Do let project screenshots and the black and white portrait be the only imagery, and take every number, date and role from the owner's résumé.
Do put new entrance, loop and scroll-linked motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and make sure the content is complete without it.
Do keep a 2px Foreground focus outline (offset 4px) on every interactive element, and tap targets of at least 44px.
Do keep text out of the scene's visible area: the scene is masked where the title sits and dimmed to 42% or less behind any section with reading text.
donts: Don't add a second accent or tint. Green is a dot of 8px or less; salmon is for form errors; hover, focus and selection are always neutral.
Don't set a heading, title or sentence in capitals, in a condensed face, or at a weight above 350.
Don't introduce a second typeface, or use Geist Mono for sentences, titles or buttons.
Don't build the page around a themed concept or metaphor; the owner rejected concept-driven design. The interface stays plain and the 3D scene is the single strong element.
Don't add a second 3D scene, put the scene on inner pages, or let it show at full strength behind reading text.

Don't add cast shadows beyond the card stack's, or glows, glass panels or gradient fills on interface surfaces. Gradients exist only as the top bar's scrim and the scene's fade mask; blur exists only in transit during a reveal.
Don't box a form field or round it; a field is one underline.
Don't stack a small label over a second, larger heading; a mono label is itself the section's heading.
Don't show a number, a live status or a link that the résumé or a working URL cannot back, and don't invent testimonials or client logos.
